test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following varna was NOT entitled to the ritual of ‘Upanayana Samskara’ in the later Vedic period?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shudra.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__**Shudra:**__

__
 
• **Shudras occupied the lowest position in terms of hierarchy.**
 
• The main task was to serve the upper three varnas and perform menial jobs
 
• They were barred from practising any rituals. 
 
• Some **Shudras** were allowed to work as farmers and traders.
 
• The **Shudra women **could marry a male from any varna. However, a **Shudra male** could marry a woman only from the Shudra varna.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **The Varna System of India:**

 
 

 **Brahman**
 The highest ranked of the four Varnasor traditional social classes of India. Includes Hindu priests, advisers and intellectual leaders.
 
 

 **Kshatriya**
 
 
The second highest of the Varnas. Include Rulers, Military Leaders, and Large Landowners.

 
 
 

 **Vaishya**
 The third highest of the four Varnas. includes merchants, traders, and farmers.
 
 

 **Dalit**
 The fifth category with no Varna designation includes various low-status people.
